convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter CML_CCI from external .mqh library (Expert\Signal\MySignals\ACML_CCI.mqh). Trading logic depends on custom indicator implementation not available as built-in MT5 indicator. Standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework with custom signal module.

other_exits: Signal-based close when CML_CCI signal strength drops below Signal_ThresholdClose (20)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size (0.1) with percent (10.0) as risk allocation parameter

custom_logic_notes: Uses CExpert standard framework with threshold-based signal system. CML_CCI is a custom composite signal filter that combines CCI with MA smoothing. The signal threshold system (ThresholdOpen=40, ThresholdClose=20) means: open when composite signal >= 40, close when signal <= 20. Weight parameter (1.0) scales the filter's contribution to the composite signal. Expert_EveryTick=false means processing occurs once per bar, not every tick. Pending order expiration set to 4 bars.
python_conversion_notes: The CML_CCI custom signal logic must be reverse-engineered from ACML_CCI.mqh before conversion. The CExpert framework handles signal aggregation, position management, and order execution automatically - these must be reimplemented in Python. Key: the threshold-based signal system (open at >=40, close at <=20) on a 0-100 scale is the core logic. CCI(18) with MA(3) smoothing is the indicator basis. No SL/TP means exits are purely signal-driven. The Expert_EveryTick=false flag means bar-close processing only, simplifying backtesting to per-bar logic. MoneyFixedLot with Lots=0.1 is straightforward fixed-lot sizing.
